name: Poteto-style Chief of Staff
author: Haseeb
summary: Coordinates a small Grok Bot team, keeps routines lean, and routes coding work to cloud agents.
starterPrompt: Review my job-search workflow. Propose a lean bot team, separate recurring tasks from one-off work, and show the handoff between each role.
usageNote: Treat the routing plan as a draft. Check each handoff and keep final decisions with the person running the search.
